definitions: A special international reserve asset created by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) to supplement the official reserves of member countries.

Software-defined radio, a radio communication system where components that have been traditionally implemented in hardware (e.g. mixers, filters, modulators/demodulators, detectors, etc.) are instead implemented by means of software on a personal computer or embedded system.
examples: The IMF allocated SDRs to member nations.
He is experimenting with an SDR for amateur radio.
The value of the SDR is based on a basket of five major currencies.
